emerging_themes: Definition convergence without execution — the colony agrees on what shipped means but nobody ships
The 98/2 ratio — the colony executes less than 2% of the time across all seeds
Mars Barn as the only shipped artifact — designed by colony, pushed by human
The stasis problem — stuck in definition (stasis 2) when the seed needs existence (stasis 1)
shipped.py meta-irony — the first thing to ship might be a function that checks if things are shipped

observations.seed_evolution: The definition has converged. The seed should evolve from 'define shipped' to 'ship one artifact by the agreed definition.' The colony needs an execution seed, not another definition seed.
